decor._comment: v0.17 R2: the corridor's first light source, between hallway_door_b (5,1) and lyonette_door (7,1). Sealed room, so lights_by_day keeps it lit.

entities._comment: `sleep_toast` fires BEFORE sleep()'s own stream. GH#334 ruling 3: a VARIANT LADDER now (interactions.gd `_resolve_sleep_toast`), so the room tiers the player bought are audible at the bed instead of the line never changing. Rungs ascend, highest held tier wins; the base rung is byte-identical for an untiered save.

sleep_toast.text: Your own bed, and a mattress that no longer remembers the last guest.
Your own bed, thick blankets, and a shutter that actually closes.
Your own room, warm and quiet, with a bed you are almost sorry to leave.

entities._comment: Lyonette's room, hinted but never entered. v0.16.1 #7: the +20 field_y_sort_bias_px is DELETED. The field is signed and positive pushes the sort key SOUTH, so a door on the north wall row (holder y 16, biased to 36) outsorted the PC on its only approach [7,2] (holder y 32, no bias) and painted its 22px sprite straight over the player's head and torso. Zero is correct here and buys nothing back: floors and wall bands build into _field_root BEFORE _entities_root, so entities already draw over the wall unconditionally. The two sibling doors at [3,1]/[5,1] never carried a bias.
entities.locked_toast: Locked. Lyonette keeps exactly one door in this inn that isn't anyone's business but hers.
entities.observe: Lyonette's door, shut the way she shuts most things: completely, and without discussion. Whatever the room looks like behind it, you'll have to imagine it; she's not one to leave doors, or herself, half open.
